verdict.rationale: Jira offers rich APIs, 3000+ Marketplace integrations, and cross-tool tracking (Slack, Figma, Gmail) plus a documented official MCP server enabling agent connectivity, which supports moving work/context across tools. However, there's no direct evidence describing context preservation specifically during agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoffs, and community reports note data-loss and UI issues (e.g., saving errors, ticket reassignment confusion) that raise doubts about seamless continuity. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of context/state preservation across handoffs, independent verification of the MCP server's agentic handoff behavior, and case studies of multi-tool agent workflows.
